Hit Die: 1d10

Class skills (automated): +1 to Craft and Art when this Class is added to a character; removed again if the Class is removed.

Class feature: Masterwork: items you craft with time and materials gain +1 to one stat the GM approves (attack, damage, Armor Value or a skill).
